name: Refuerzo
description: You can use a bonus action on your turn to choose one ally other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can see or hear you. That ally can add a d6 to one D20 Test it fails or damage roll it makes within the next 10 minutes. An ally being helped can only have one d6 available at a time.
higherLevels: El dado de ayuda para este movimiento pasa a ser un d8 al nivel 5, un d10 al nivel 10 y un d12 al nivel 17.

updated.details: Allow use on failure and on damage rolls.
